subject: DataForge competitive terms, migration protections, and packaging options
messages:
From: Amira Khatri <amira@dataforge.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: procure@dataforge.com
Date: 2026-12-10T09:13:00-08:00
Subject: Pricing alignment request + migration protections

Stephanie,

Thanks for the kickoff last week. Procurement asked me to follow up with the concrete ask so we can table this internally: DataForge is evaluating Redwood to replace our current vendor, Inferra. Before we take this to execs we need a clear commercial offer that includes: a competitive price match or better against the Inferra unit rates (I attached their quote), a one-time migration credit to cover integration/engineering effort, and contractual protections if rollout doesn't meet expected throughput (rollback/repayment or credits).

Key constraints:
- We prefer month-to-month billing or short-term commitments (6–12 months) while we validate latency and reliability under our workload.
- Security & ATO docs must be provided before procurement final sign-off.
- Prefer a no-risk pilot window (30–90 days) where we can opt-out without long-term penalties.

Please propose a matched pricing structure and how Redwood would handle migration credits and rollback protection.

Attaching: inferra_quote.pdf (redacted pricing)

Best,
Amira
Amira Khatri
Head of Procurement | DataForge
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Amira Khatri <amira@dataforge.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-11T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing alignment request + migration protections

Amira — thanks for the clarity and the Inferra quote. Appreciate the constraints; we can be creative here. High-level proposal below (draft until we align on scope and SLA definitions):

1) Price match:
- We can match Inferra list price on the core inference unit for the first 12 months, plus an additional 10% effective discount on embedding and fine-tuning units for customers moving from a competitor. This requires a 12-month committed consumption baseline (we'll put an agreed-upon monthly minimum in the SOW).

2) Migration credit:
- One-time migration credit of up to $150,000 applied as platform credits over the first 6 months (can be used for token usage and onboarding services). If you prefer an upfront engineering credit to Redwood Professional Services, we can split the credit 60/40 (service vs credits).

3) Risk-sharing / rollback protection:
- Staged milestone credits rather than an unconditional payout. Example: 10% of the credit on contract signing, 40% on pilot go-live, 50% after 90 days of successful throughput/latency validation.
- If you exercise an opt-out within the pilot window due to performance non-conformance against agreed SLOs, remaining credits are refundable or not charged. We can define a 90-day validation period with objective metrics (p95 latency, error rate, throughput).

4) Pilot & commitment flexibility:
- We can do a 90-day pilot on dedicated slices with telemetry access and a single-month extension option. If you need strictly month-to-month billing after pilot, we can convert to month-to-month with a slightly reduced migration credit (tradeoff for no term).

5) Security & ATO:
- I'll loop in our security team for SOC2/attestations and we can provide the standard ATO pack within 3 business days of LOI.

I'll attach a draft term sheet and an integration checklist for your technical team. If this direction works, let's schedule a 30-minute commercial call with Jordan & Connor to iron out exact numbers and SLO language.

Best,

On Thu, Dec 10, 2026 at 09:13 AM Amira Khatri <amira@dataforge.com> wrote:
> Stephanie,
>
> Thanks for the kickoff last week... (inferra quote attached)
>
> —Amira

--
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
From: Amira Khatri <amira@dataforge.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: procure@dataforge.com
Date: 2026-12-14T10:21:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing alignment request + migration protections

Thanks, Stephanie. Helpful start. A couple of pushbacks from Procurement/Eng: 

- Inferra showed us a one-time migration credit of $200k and a 20% discount on contracted units for year one (they did require a 12-month commitment). To win the deal we'd need to be at least as favorable on economic terms or give compensating protections (longer credits or stronger rollback assurance).
- Procurement is resistant to any hard 12-month minimum unless it's tied to an expiry/reverse-vesting of credits if we leave early. They'd accept a 12-month lookback floor if we get a 180-day rollback window with a defined credit repayment schedule.
- Engineering wants a clear statement that Redwood's runtime will support our mixed seq-length workflows without >2x latency vs Inferra's baseline during peak windows.

Also, security expects SOC2 + pen test report; we can start legal redlines once we have a term sheet.

Can you come back with a concrete commercial table: option A (12-month commit + $150k credit + 30% match on some SKUs), option B (no-commit pilot with reduced credit), and the milestone / repayment math?

Appreciate it — I'll get procurement prepped for a final call next week.

—Amira
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Amira Khatri <amira@dataforge.com>, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-17T14:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing alignment request + migration protections

Amira — Jordan here (Director, Strategic Accounts). Thanks for the details. Below is a concrete, negotiable table and the operational guardrails we'd propose. This is intentionally pragmatic to bridge Procurement and Eng concerns.

Commercial options (draft):

Option A — Commit + Max Credit (recommended for lowest unit cost)
- Commitment: 12-month committed baseline equal to 60% of your current monthly run-rate (flexible by mutual agreement).
- Pricing: Match Inferra unit price on core inference units for 12 months + additional 10% discount on embeddings & tuning.
- Credit: $175,000 migration credit applied over first 6 months.
- Rollback: 180-day rollback window. If you cancel within 180 days for performance reasons, credits are prorated and any unearned portion is refunded per a simple schedule (we can define exact prorate math in SOW).

Option B — Pilot-first (lower risk, faster start)
- Commitment: No initial term commitment; 90-day pilot on reserved slices (metered).
- Pricing: Standard hosted rates with a one-time $80,000 pilot credit (applies to usage).
- Credit earn-in: If you convert to a 12-month commit within 120 days post-pilot, we top up to $150,000 total.
- Rollback: 90-day evaluation period with tech acceptance gates.

Risk-sharing & milestone mechanics (applies to both options):
- Credit earned in three tranches: 10% at signature, 40% at pilot go-live, 50% after 90 days of validated SLOs.
- If SLA metrics miss targets by >10% for two consecutive weeks during validation, we trigger a remediation plan and a short-term credit increase in lieu of termination (helps avoid wholesale churn).

Operational items we will include in SOW/Annex:
- Performance SLA appendix with p95 latency targets, throughput baselines, and measurement method (open to using your telemetry or a mutually-agreed agent).
- Integration checklist (attached) and a named Solutions Engineer to assist the first 45 days.
- Security deliverables: SOC2 Type II, pen test summary, and data flow diagrams; we’ll open a security intake ticket on signature.

Attachments: redwood-switch-term-sheet.pdf (draft commercial table), integration-checklist.xlsx.

If this structure looks acceptable, Stephanie/Connor and I can join procurement on a short call to finalize the exact numbers and draft the LOI.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
From: Amira Khatri <amira@dataforge.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: procure@dataforge.com
Date: 2026-12-20T16:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing alignment request + migration protections

Jordan/Stephanie — this is a reasonable set of options. Procurement will prefer Option A with the $175k credit if Redwood will accept the 180-day rollback and a clear repayment/prorate schedule; engineering will want a short technical deep-dive to lock acceptance gates.

Next steps from our side:
- I'll share the Inferra redline and a short ops acceptance checklist by Monday.
- Please send an updated term sheet reflecting Option A numbers and the exact earn-in/prorate math.
- Let's schedule a 45-minute call for next Wed (12/24) at 10am PT to finalize.

I'll loop legal once we have the updated term sheet. Thanks — looks promising.

—Amira
Amira Khatri
Head of Procurement | DataForge
